title: First Salary Day Checklist
description: Critical administrative and financial hygiene actions to take the week your first salary arrives.

items.label: Audit Payslip Deductions
items.detail: Verify Employee PF (12% of basic) and TDS match your offer letter annexure.

items.label: Activate Bank Auto-Sweep
items.detail: Set a ₹25,000 threshold so excess idle cash earns 6.5%+ in sweep FDs.

items.label: Apply the 50/30/20 Rule
items.detail: Transfer 20% immediately to savings before paying discretionary bills.

items.label: Register Nominee on Bank Account
items.detail: Add parents or spouse as registered nominee via net banking.

items.label: Seed UAN on EPFO Portal
items.detail: Log in to unifiedportal-mem.epfindia.gov.in and activate your Universal Account Number.

title: Before Applying for Your First Credit Card
description: Essential safeguards to prevent CIBIL damage and avoid predatory fee structures.

items.label: Choose a Lifetime-Free (LTF) Card
items.detail: Avoid high annual fee cards until your spending organically justifies reward structures.

items.label: Check Existing CIBIL Score Once
items.detail: Ensure your baseline score is 700+; do not apply if you have recent defaults.

items.label: Avoid Multiple Simultaneous Applications
items.detail: Applying to 4 banks in 1 week generates multiple hard inquiries, dropping your score.

items.label: Enable Total Amount Auto-Debit
items.detail: Set net banking auto-debit for 'Total Amount Due' so you never miss a due date.

items.label: Turn Off International & ATM Cash Withdrawal
items.detail: Disable ATM cash withdrawal in app settings (credit card ATM withdrawals incur immediate 40%+ interest with zero grace period).

title: Opening Your First Mutual Fund Account
description: Checklist to ensure 100% of your compounding returns work for you without broker leakage.

items.label: Verify 'Direct Plan - Growth' Selection
items.detail: Never choose Regular plans (paying ongoing agent commission) or IDCW dividend options.

items.label: Check Expense Ratio (< 0.25%)
items.detail: Choose broad index funds (Nifty 50 or Nifty Next 50) with rock-bottom expense ratios.

items.label: Set SIP Date on the 3rd or 5th of the Month
items.detail: Align automated debit right after salary credit so you invest before lifestyle spending.

items.label: Add 2 Nominees with Allocation Percentage
items.detail: Specify nominee PAN and legal relationship in the Demat/AMC folio.

items.label: Commit to a 5-Year Holding Horizon
items.detail: Promise yourself not to stop your SIP during normal market pullbacks.

title: First Insurance Policy Buying Checklist
description: Audit protection coverage and eliminate high-commission agent mis-selling.

items.label: Reject Any Plan Offering 'Maturity Returns'
items.detail: If it promises money back, it is an endowment/ULIP giving sub-5% returns. Buy pure term cover only.

items.label: Calculate Sum Assured (15x-20x Annual Income)
items.detail: Ensure minimum cover is ₹1 Crore to ₹1.5 Crore to adequately protect dependents.

items.label: Disclose 100% Truthful Medical History
items.detail: Declare smoking, alcohol, prior surgeries, or family illness so claims can never be contested.

items.label: Get a Personal ₹5-10L Health Base Policy
items.detail: Do not rely on employer corporate cover that vanishes if you change jobs or get laid off.

items.label: Verify Claim Settlement Ratio (> 98%)
items.detail: Check official IRDAI public disclosures for consistent multi-year settlement rates.
